stateDiagram-v2
[*] --> Disabled
Disabled --> Recording: Core enables explicit bounded capture policy
Recording --> Recording: Append redacted chunk within quota
Recording --> Sealed: Invocation ends or capture is manually stopped
Recording --> Truncated: Per-capture quota queue pressure or disk pressure
Truncated --> Sealed: Seal manifest with truncation reason
Sealed --> Available: Hash and manifest verify
Sealed --> CorruptDiscarded: Verification fails
Available --> Expired: Independent TTL or global quota selects capture
Expired --> Purged: Reader leases released and GC commits tombstone
CorruptDiscarded --> Purged: Preserve only unavailable metadata
Purged --> [*]
Available --> Recording: New CaptureId for later bounded scope
Disabled --> [*]: Semantic history continues normally

data.title: Independent Detailed Capture Retention and Degradation
